hints.title: Subsegment Length Tracking Obstacle
hints.text: Valid pairs may be separated by invalid characters. How can tracking index boundaries allow you to measure contiguous valid spans without rechecking substrings?

hints.title: Base Index Boundary Invariant
hints.text: Store unmatched indices so the difference between current index and the top unmatched index gives the contiguous valid length.

hints.title: Index Difference Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Initialize an index list with -1. For each index i and char c in s: if c is '(', push i. If c is ')', pop. If empty, push i as the new base boundary. Otherwise, update maxLen with i minus the current top index. Return maxLen.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of string s (0 <= N <= 3 * 10^4)
complexity.notes: Single pass tracking boundary indices in O(N) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(N^2) substrings takes O(N^3) time, timing out on inputs of 30,000 characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing indices rather than characters computes contiguous valid lengths in O(1) time per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Initializing with index -1 so valid substrings starting at index 0 correctly compute length i - (-1) = i + 1.
